# weir provider

<!-- Generated by `weir reference`. Do not edit: change the help text in src/main.rs and regenerate. -->

Manage provider hosts (only needed for self-hosted providers).

```text
Manage provider hosts (only needed for self-hosted providers)

Usage: weir provider [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  add   Add a provider host
  list  List provider hosts

Options:
      --json
          Machine-readable output

  -q, --quiet
          Print errors only

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## weir provider add

Add a provider host.

```text
Add a provider host

Usage: weir provider add [OPTIONS] <KIND> <HOST>

Arguments:
  <KIND>
          github, gitlab, bitbucket or local

  <HOST>


Options:
      --api-url <API_URL>
          The API base URL; for `local`, a directory of bare repositories

      --json
          Machine-readable output

  -q, --quiet
          Print errors only

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## weir provider list

List provider hosts.

```text

          Print errors only

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
